## ​What We Treat

​We support people experiencing a range of musculoskeletal conditions. Everyone is assessed individually, with care tailored to their specific needs, goals and lifestyle.

##### Neck Pain

Relieving tension and restoring mobility through evidence-based rehabilitation and patient-centred care.

![ChatGPT Image Sep 5, 2026, 07_07_10 PM.png](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/656d2f_fd5348649a3c4ec985ac0a9b5990e458~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_77,h_56,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/ChatGPT%20Image%20Sep%205%2C%202026%2C%2007_07_10%20PM.png)

##### Back Pain & Sciatica

Chiropractic care can help with general, acute and chronic back pain. We also assess and provide care for people experiencing sciatica, with treatment tailored to your individual needs.

![ChatGPT Image Sep 5, 2026, 06_54_52 PM.png](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/656d2f_40ccb3c2454b4d06873745b80c383d01~mv2.png/v1/crop/x_0,y_165,w_1254,h_1007/fill/w_91,h_72,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/ChatGPT%20Image%20Sep%205%2C%202026%2C%2006_54_52%20PM.png)

##### Headaches & Migraine Prevention

​If your headaches are linked to your neck, chiropractic care may help. We can support people experiencing headaches arising from the neck (cervicogenic headaches), as well as those seeking chiropractic care as part of migraine prevention.

##### Shoulder & Joint Pain

​Chiropractic care can help with joint pains and shoulder complaints, including shoulder pain and dysfunction.

##### Minor Sports Injuries

​Chiropractic care can help with minor sports injuries, including strains, sprains and repetitive strain injuries.

##### Mobility & Movement

Improving your range of motion and overall movement quality through functional rehabilitation and care.

# 01

##### Consultation

Your first appointment begins with a detailed consultation. We will discuss your current symptoms, medical history, lifestyle, and health goals to gain a complete understanding of your condition and how it may be affecting your daily life.

# 03

##### Diagnosis and Treatment Plan

​Once your assessment is complete, your chiropractor will explain the findings in clear, easy-to-understand language. If chiropractic care is appropriate for you, we’ll discuss a personalised care plan based on your individual needs, including recommended treatment, your goals and the expected duration of care.

A clear roadmap to your initial appointment with us.

## Your First Visit

# 02

##### Examination

​A thorough chiropractic examination will then be carried out, which may include posture and movement assessment, range of motion testing, and neurological and orthopaedic examinations. These assessments help us understand your symptoms, identify possible contributing factors and determine the most appropriate approach to your care.

# 04

##### Your First Treatment

​In most cases, where appropriate, treatment can begin during your first visit. Depending on your assessment and individual needs, this may include chiropractic adjustments, mobilisation, soft tissue techniques and personalised exercise and movement advice to support your recovery.

## Mouse — Clinic Manager 🐾

After deciding he’d had quite enough of life on the streets of Hackney, Mouse found his forever home with Dan and has since appointed himself Clinic Manager.

He may only have one eye, but very little escapes his attention. His responsibilities include supervising the day-to-day running of the clinic, making sure Dan takes regular breaks, greeting visitors when the mood takes him, and maintaining a very demanding nap schedule.

Mouse takes a relaxed approach to management and stays out of the treatment room. You might, however, spot him on your way into the clinic, napping in his hammock by the window. If you’re happy to meet him and don’t have a cat allergy, he may even make an appearance to say hello.

### Danilo (Dan) Milic

DC MChiro \| GCC Registered: 06444

Originally from Yugoslavia, Dan moved to the UK over 30 years ago and has proudly made it his home. He graduated from London South Bank University with a Master of Chiropractic Degree (MChiro) and is fully registered with the General Chiropractic Council.

Dan has a strong interest in sports rehabilitation and functional movement, helping patients restore strength, stability and confidence following injury, surgery or periods of reduced activity. His approach focuses on identifying the underlying causes of symptoms, improving biomechanics and supporting long-term recovery rather than simply providing short-term relief.

Alongside his clinical practice, Dan actively practises Iyengar yoga, which has deepened his appreciation for posture, alignment, balance and mindful movement. This perspective complements his clinical work, particularly when supporting patients with hypermobility, stability concerns and rehabilitation-focused care.

As a neurodivergent and queer practitioner, Dan values creating a welcoming, inclusive and supportive environment where every patient feels understood, respected and empowered in their healthcare journey. He recognises that each person's experience of pain, movement and wellbeing is unique, and tailors his care accordingly.

Dan is passionate about helping people of all ages move better, feel stronger and return to the activities they enjoy. His aim is not only to guide patients through recovery but also to help them build long-term resilience, confidence and lasting health.

## Your First Visit

​We understand that visiting a chiropractor for the first time can feel unfamiliar, so we’ll make sure your experience is comfortable, welcoming and informative from the moment you arrive.

##### 1\. Consultation

# ​

General

- 01












### How many chiropractic sessions will I need?


































Everyone is different, so the number of sessions will depend on your individual needs, symptoms and how you respond to care. Some people may notice improvement within a few visits, while others may benefit from a longer period of care and rehabilitation.



Following your initial assessment, we’ll discuss our recommendations with you, including your treatment options and likely timescales. Your progress will be reviewed regularly, and your care plan can be adjusted as needed.

- 02












### What conditions can chiropractic care help with?


































Chiropractic care can help with a range of musculoskeletal conditions, including back pain, mechanical neck pain, joint pain, muscle spasms, headaches arising from the neck (cervicogenic headaches) and minor sports injuries. Chiropractic care may also be used for migraine prevention.



During your consultation, we’ll carry out a thorough assessment to determine whether chiropractic care is appropriate for your individual needs. If chiropractic care isn’t suitable, we’ll discuss the appropriate next steps with you.

- 03












### Do you accept health insurance?


































Yes. However, we do not bill health insurance providers directly. **Patients are required to pay for their treatment at the time of their appointment and then claim reimbursement from their insurer themselves.**



**Please check with your insurance provider before booking** to confirm that chiropractic care with your chosen chiropractor is covered under your policy and whether you need prior authorisation.



We will provide you with invoices and receipts to support your claim. Please note that reimbursement is subject to the terms and limits of your individual insurance policy.

- 04












### Does chiropractic treatment cause pain?


































Chiropractic treatment is not normally painful, although some techniques may cause temporary discomfort. Some chiropractic adjustments involve a quick, controlled movement of a joint and may produce a clicking or popping sound.



Some people may experience mild soreness or stiffness following treatment, similar to how you might feel after exercise. This is usually temporary and settles within a few days.



Your care will always be tailored to your individual needs and comfort, and your chiropractor will explain the techniques being used and discuss any concerns you may have.

- 05












### Is chiropractic treatment safe?


































Chiropractic treatment is generally considered safe when carried out appropriately by a trained and registered chiropractor. As with any form of healthcare treatment, there can be risks and side effects. Some people may experience temporary soreness, stiffness or tiredness following treatment, while more serious complications are rare.



Before treatment, your chiropractor will take a detailed medical history and carry out an appropriate examination to make sure chiropractic care is suitable for you. We’ll explain the proposed treatment, including relevant benefits, risks and alternatives, and you’ll always have the opportunity to ask questions before deciding whether to proceed.
